titulo.alumno: Mediating between specialists and the public

intro: Paraphrase technical terms in plain language and check that they keep their scope and limits.

piezas.titulo: Making things clear without distorting them
texto: When explaining a concept, give a short definition, an example and the relevant limit. Simplifying does not mean removing conditions that change the meaning. Check the paraphrase against the technical source and with a target reader if possible.

frases.estudio: Fagtekst: «Forebyggende vedlikehold reduserer risikoen for uplanlagt driftsstans, men eliminerer den ikke.» Enkel forklaring: «Hvis utstyr kontrolleres jevnlig, blir plutselige stopp mindre sannsynlige. De kan likevel skje.» Eksempel: en planlagt sjekk kan oppdage slitasje før en del slutter å virke.
frases.alumno: Technical text: «Preventive maintenance reduces the risk of unplanned downtime, but it does not eliminate it». Simple explanation: «If equipment is checked regularly, sudden breakdowns are less likely. Even so, they can still happen». Example: a scheduled inspection can detect wear before a part stops working.

pregunta.texto: What limit does the simple explanation keep?

opciones.explicacion: The simple version keeps the point that maintenance reduces the risk, but does not eliminate it.

opciones.texto: Maintenance guarantees there will be no faults
opciones.explicacion: The text explicitly says it does not eliminate them.
The example says an inspection can detect wear.

pregunta.texto: Paraphrase a technical term for a general audience with a definition, an example and a limit.

textos: En sikkerhetskopi er en ekstra kopi av filene dine. Den kan gjenopprette data hvis noe går galt, men du må lage og oppdatere kopien.

piezas.explicacion: Model: define, give an example of use and keep one important condition.
